name: Psibane (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 8th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

Psibane weapons were developed for fighting those gifted with strange powers of the mind.

Against enemies capable of manifesting psionic powers, the weapon’s enhancement bonus is +2 better than its actual bonus. It also deals an extra 2d6 points of damage to them. A creature capable of manifesting psychic or psionic powers takes a -1 penalty to concentration and autohypnosis checks when holding a psibane weapon.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Mage Slayer
